audit_scope: Corrected 98-feature raw-tail direct-short HGB model and its q99.97 backtest

checks.name: configuration_target
checks.detail: Direct-downside target is next-session open-to-close return <= -1.2%.

checks.name: configuration_raw_tail

checks.detail: Eligibility independently reconstructed from raw score, historical q99.97 threshold, volatility, and prior-day liquidity.

checks.name: backtest_trade_reproduction

checks.name: backtest_equity_reproduction
checks.detail: Independent simulation reproduces the daily equity curve.

checks.name: backtest_summary_reproduction
checks.detail: Independent performance summary matches the stored result.

limitations: This audit verifies artifact consistency, causal date boundaries, and deterministic reproduction. It cannot prove that the original vendor OHLCV/index files are economically correct or point-in-time constituent-clean.
Daily OHLC cannot establish intraday order sequence, stop fill quality, spread, market impact, stock borrow, or short-sale availability.
The 2020-2026 walk-forward sequence is historical model-selection evidence, not an untouched final validation set after all later strategy and risk-rule decisions.
